scope: The W120 precondition and cleared predicate consume source-current complete reports; the actual diagnostics publication listener is installed before each current-report request. The listener's timeout resolves false instead of rejecting while the report request is pending, avoiding an unhandled rejection. One scaled 20s/30s source-result budget remains per phase; variable completion restore uses one scaled 10s source-and-complete-result window. Caller source bytes and version remain checked after the watched update.
preserved: No selector, assertion, fixture, Native execution, assertion weakening, or budget extension. Genuine complete reports that do not satisfy the W120 predicate continue waiting for a real publish until the original deadline.
review_basis: Source inspection against exact catalogue rows, current-diagnostics publisher owner and existing extension wait contract. v3 held only for its timer rejection race; this successor changes only that waiter's timeout settlement.
validation: git apply --check succeeded against current source. No test, build, Cargo, or main execution performed. Fresh forward/inverse application was not performed.
